title: Public website UX, accessibility, and performance hardening
objective: Raise the already-live Deskal GitHub Pages site to a polished, professional launch-quality UX by hardening responsive navigation, accessibility, metadata, interaction polish, and static performance while preserving the approved brand geometry, evidence-bounded copy, zero-telemetry posture, existing hosting model, and all Deskal runtime authority.

include: responsive information architecture and mobile navigation for the existing static marketing site
keyboard-visible focus, touch-target sizing, semantic landmarks, reduced-motion behavior, and contrast-safe presentation
canonical page metadata for title, description, canonical URL, Open Graph, and social sharing without remote runtime dependencies
visual hierarchy, spacing, surface, and interaction polish consistent with the approved black/white website identity and full-color product mark
static source-level regression tests for approved logo geometry, launch links, accessibility invariants, metadata, no-client-runtime additions, and forbidden hosted dependencies
build-time verification that the website remains a zero-cost static export deployable by the existing GitHub Pages workflow
exclude: changing the canonical Deskal logo geometry or replacing the approved logo asset
adding analytics, tracking, telemetry, cookies, authentication, forms, payments, hosted APIs, databases, user accounts, or mandatory cloud services
adding remote fonts, remote images, third-party runtime scripts, or new website package dependencies
changing GitHub Pages configuration, custom domain, DNS, deployment credentials, repository visibility, merge policy, branch protection, Actions permissions, secrets, environments, or collaborators
creating, editing, publishing, deleting, or retagging any GitHub Release or tag
installer changes, package publication, compatibility identifier migration, or alternate artifact distribution
changes to Deskal runtime, MCP tools, policy, approvals, trust, leases, providers, browser authority, desktop authority, filesystem authority, network authority, or process authority

authority_delta.filesystem: Static website source, metadata, and website regression tests only; no Deskal runtime filesystem authority change.
authority_delta.process: Build/test process for apps/web only; no Deskal runtime process authority change.
authority_delta.network: No new runtime network dependency. Existing GitHub Pages deployment and canonical outbound launch links remain unchanged.
authority_delta.browser: Public static presentation only; no browser-control authority change.
authority_delta.ui_input: Website navigation and links only; no local computer input authority change.

invariants: the approved Deskal logo geometry remains byte-identical to the canonical pinned asset
website header uses the white mark on black while product illustrations may use the existing full-color mark
the site remains a static export with no client-side authority surface and no mandatory hosted runtime dependency
public copy remains evidence-bounded and does not imply arbitrary execution, silent elevation, remote self-approval, or cloud authority
the site introduces no analytics, tracking, forms, authentication, payments, cookies, remote fonts, remote images, or third-party runtime scripts
GitHub Pages hosting mode, repository metadata, Releases, tags, and all Deskal runtime/MCP authority remain unchanged

acceptance.claim: The existing approved logo asset hash and shared geometry contract remain unchanged, with white website and full-color product treatments derived from that one geometry.

Primary navigation remains usable by keyboard and touch across desktop and mobile breakpoints, focus is visible, semantic navigation/landmarks are preserved, and reduced-motion preferences are honored.
Canonical title, description, canonical URL, Open Graph, and social metadata are present and point only to the canonical Deskal identity and GitHub Pages surface.
The visual system is materially polished without new package dependencies, remote assets, analytics, telemetry, tracking, forms, authentication, payments, or client-side hosted services.
The website remains a static export and its build/test path stays isolated from the privileged runtime dependency graph; source-level regression tests prove the no-runtime-authority boundary.

Exact-head CI, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, manual review of exclusions, zero unresolved blocking review threads, normal merge, Pages deployment verification, and post-merge CI complete before canonical closeout.

done_when: The polished static site is merged from an exact qualified head, the approved logo geometry remains unchanged, accessibility/metadata/static-performance regressions pass, GitHub Pages deploys successfully at the canonical URL, excluded repository/release/runtime surfaces remain unchanged, and post-merge CI is green.
